csv.title: Import {{name}}
csv.explanation_one: {{separator}} as delimiter, {{count}} column. Choose Text for postcodes, item numbers and IBANs; leading zeros and numbers longer than 15 digits already stay text in General. Values starting with =, +, - or @ are never imported as formulas (apostrophe in the preview).
csv.explanation_other: {{separator}} as delimiter, {{count}} columns. Choose Text for postcodes, item numbers and IBANs; leading zeros and numbers longer than 15 digits already stay text in General. Values starting with =, +, - or @ are never imported as formulas (apostrophe in the preview).

errors.encrypted: This file is encrypted with a password.
errors.unsupportedFormat: This file format is not supported yet.
errors.textTooLarge: This text file is too large to open without the office runtime (maximum 32 MB).
errors.cannotConvert: The app cannot convert this format ({{ext}}) by itself.
errors.notRtf: This is not an RTF file: the {\rtf header is missing.
errors.macroFileOnly: Saving as .{{ext}} is only possible for a document that was opened as a macro file.
errors.noWebCrypto: This environment has no WebCrypto; encrypted files cannot be opened.
errors.tooManyHashRounds: Too many hash rounds in this file.
errors.dataNotBlockAligned: Data is not aligned to the block size.
errors.encryptedDataNotBlockAligned: Encrypted data is not aligned to the block size.
errors.chainingNotSupported: This encryption mode is not supported.
errors.integrityFailed: The integrity check of the encrypted file failed; the file is damaged or has been modified.
errors.encryptedPackageTooLarge: The encrypted package is too large.
errors.rc4NotSupported: This (RC4) encryption is not supported; only AES.
errors.rc4Binary: This .{{format}} file is password protected (RC4, old binary format). The app can recognise this kind of encryption but cannot open it. Open it in the original program and save it without a password, or as .{{format}}x with a password.
errors.unknownEncryption: This file uses an unknown encryption (version {{version}}) and cannot be opened.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password can be at most 255 characters long.

password.title: Password Required
password.explanation: {{name}} is encrypted with a password. The password is only used to open the file on this device and is not stored.

pdfExport.viaRuntime: Use the office runtime (PDF/A, headings as bookmarks)

ui.copyNotAllowed: Copying is not allowed; use Save instead.

head.conversion: Imported as an editable copy; the original is preserved.
head.conversionWithItems: Imported as an editable copy; the original is preserved. Note: {{items}}.
head.import: Converted to an editable .{{format}} copy; the original is preserved.
head.importWithItems: Converted to an editable .{{format}} copy; the original is preserved. Note: {{items}}.

open.keptSpreadsheet: Preservation on saving has not yet been measured for spreadsheets; keep the original.
open.kept: They are preserved when saving as .{{format}}.
open.embeddedObjects: Shown only as a preview image and cannot be edited here. {{kept}}
open.charts: Shown as {{module}} can draw them; unknown chart types or formatting may differ. {{kept}}
open.customXml: Not shown; linked content controls are not updated. {{kept}}
open.controls: Not run and cannot be operated. {{kept}}
open.signature: Not verified. After editing and saving, the signature is no longer valid.
open.pivotTables: Shown as ordinary cells and not refreshed.
open.slicers: Not shown and do not filter.
open.externalLinks: Not updated; the last saved values remain.
open.protection: This is not encryption: the file opens without a password. The app does not enforce the protection and keeps the setting unchanged.
open.conversion: The .{{source}} file was converted by the office runtime into an editable .{{format}} copy. The original has not been changed. Formatting may differ; macros and active content were not run and are not carried over.
open.conversionLoss: Present in the original; these are lost on conversion (demonstrated in the test matrix).
open.macrosNotCopied: Never run and not carried over into this copy. Keep the original.

save.macrosLost: .{{ext}} cannot contain macros; the VBA project is not saved. Choose a macro-enabled format to keep it.
save.unencrypted: The original was encrypted with a password; this copy is saved without a password and can be read by anyone.
save.engineLoss: The editor does not preserve these when saving (demonstrated in the test matrix); saving is refused.
save.conversionLoss: Lost on conversion (demonstrated in the test matrix). The original remains unchanged.
save.notMeasured: Preservation when converting with the office runtime has not been measured; check the copy.
save.signature: Not carried over, or no longer valid after saving.
save.olderFormat: .{{ext}} (Office 97–2003) does not support all newer formatting, sizes and features; these may change or disappear. Choose .{{format}} to keep everything.
save.textFormatLoss: Present in the document; these are not included in this format, or only as text.

saving.vbaRestored: The VBA project has been restored unchanged; macros were not run.
saving.passwordSaved: Saved with a password (ECMA-376 Agile, AES-256). The file cannot be opened without the password.

sources.decrypted: The file has been decrypted ({{method}}). The password has not been stored; choose a password again in Save As to protect the copy.
sources.vbaKept: The VBA project is never run and is preserved byte for byte when saving as .{{format}}.
sources.vbaKeptWithModules: The VBA project ({{modules}}) is never run and is preserved byte for byte when saving as .{{format}}.
sources.vbaSigned: The project's digital signature is carried over unchanged.
sources.vbaRemovedOnSave: Saving as .{{format}} removes the macros (with a warning first).
sources.noVbaProject: This .{{ext}} file contains no VBA project; it stays a .{{format}} when saved.
sources.runtimeFailed: Conversion with the runtime failed ({{error}}); the built-in reader was used.
sources.truncated: The file is larger than a worksheet (1,048,576 rows or 16,384 columns); the rest was not imported.
sources.dateSystem1904: The workbook counts dates from 1 January 1904 (like older Mac Excel). Dates are shown correctly and the date system is preserved on saving; if you copy dates to a workbook using the 1900 system, they shift by 1462 days.
sources.txt: Detected as {{encoding}}; line endings: {{lineEndings}}. Each line has become a paragraph.
sources.markdown: Headings, lists, links, tables, code and quotes have been carried over (encoding {{encoding}}).
sources.embeddedHtml: Only the text and simple formatting have been carried over; scripts and styles have not.
sources.footnotes: Shown as ordinary text with a reference number, not as real footnotes.
sources.html: Text, headings, formatting, lists, tables and links have been carried over (encoding {{encoding}}). Scripts, style sheets, forms and external resources were not loaded or run; the page layout may differ.
sources.forms: Form fields have been carried over as text and do not work.
sources.rtf: Read with the simple built-in RTF reader: text, basic formatting, headings, simple tables, links and PNG/JPEG images. List numbering appears as text.
sources.rtfSkipped: Not carried over ({{times}}×). Open the file in the desktop app with the office runtime for a more complete conversion.
sources.formulaLike_one: {{cells}} cell starting with =, +, - or @ was imported as text, not as a formula (protection against CSV injection).
sources.formulaLike_other: {{cells}} cells starting with =, +, - or @ were imported as text, not as formulas (protection against CSV injection).
sources.markdownImages_one: {{images}} image with an external or local path was not retrieved and appears as text in the document. Only embedded data images (PNG, JPEG, GIF) are carried over.
sources.markdownImages_other: {{images}} images with an external or local path were not retrieved and appear as text in the document. Only embedded data images (PNG, JPEG, GIF) are carried over.
sources.htmlImages_one: {{images}} external image was not retrieved and appears as text in the document.
sources.htmlImages_other: {{images}} external images were not retrieved and appear as text in the document.
